messages.subject: Stratton — open issues note for client
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Draft issues note attached for Rebecca and Daniel ahead of the 27th. Headline recommendation: concede the cap to 125% and accept a 200% IP sub-cap as a package, while holding the consequential-loss exclusion, a 4% price-review cap, the 15% shortfall and the post-second-anniversary convenience right. Grateful for your sign-off before I send.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
